claims.claim: Severian of Gabala was the bishop of Gabala in Syria and lived approximately from 355 to 408/425.
He was a popular preacher in Constantinople during the first years of the fifth century, especially between about 400 and 404.
Severian authored a work known as the "Fragments on the Letter to the Hebrews" (Fragmenta in epistulam ad Hebraeos).
Its purpose was to defend the Pauline authorship of the Letter to the Hebrews against heretical claims that the epistle was not written by Paul.
The fragments survive only in quotation within later catenae and scholia collections, most notably in the Greek manuscript GA 1910 (Typus Parisinus, CPG C162) and in GA 1900 (CPG C166).
